sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXII OF 2016
ACT XXII OF 2016
OFFENCES IN RESPECT OF
BANKS (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An Act further to amend
the Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 10th May, 2016]
No. F. 9(5)/2016-Legis, dated 10.5.2016.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
May, 2016 and is hereby published for general information:--
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Offences in
Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984 (IX of 1984) for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) (Amendment)
Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

No. F. 9(5)/2016-Legis, dated 10.5.2016.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
May, 2016 and is hereby published for general information:--
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Offences in
Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984 (IX of 1984) for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Insertion of new section 10A, Ordinance No.
IX of 1984.---In
the Offences in Respect of Banks (Special Courts) Ordinance, 1984 (IX of
1984) after section 10, the following new section 10A, shall be inserted,
namely:-
10A. Appeal in case of
acquittal.---If
an order of acquittal is passed by the Special Court in any case, the High
Court may, on an application made within the thirty days by an aggrieved party
in this behalf, grant special leave to appeal from the order of acquittal,
whereupon the aggrieved party may present such an appeal to the
High Court.
